ROUTH-HURWITZ STABILITY ANALYSIS & SPECIAL CASES ARCHITECTURE
CASE 1: Leading Element Zero (Row Not All Zero)
• Cause: First term vanishes, causing division-by-zero.
• Remedy A: Replace 0 with small ε > 0, complete array, take ε → 0.
• Remedy B: Substitute s = 1/z (reciprocal roots) and rebuild array.
Sign changes with ε > 0 indicate RHP roots.
CASE 2: Entire Row of Zeros (Symmetric Roots)
• Cause: Symmetrically placed roots (±σ, ±jω, or quad ±σ±jω).
• Remedy: Form Auxiliary Eq A(s) from row directly above.
• Differentiate dA(s)/ds and use coefficients in place of zero row.
Roots of A(s) = 0 yield sustained oscillation frequency ω = √(c/a).
